description: Play Nigerian Whot in the browser. 54 cards, Hold on, Pick two, Suspension and the wild Whot 20, against a friend in a private room or the computer.
controls: Click or tap a card in your hand to play it
Click the market pile to pick a card
Click Create room, then share the 6 letter code
Click Play vs computer for a game without a room
howToPlay: You and your opponent get 6 cards each.
Match the shape or the number on the call card.
Play a Whot 20 on anything and call the shape that comes next.
Answer Pick two with another 2, or pick the cards yourself.
Empty your hand first to win the round.
features: An AI opponent you can play offline
Built for phones as well as desktops
